g.text: Variants: the return channel, and where workers run
Results, questions and approvals reach you when the voice AI
calls: send, ask, get_reply, status. After you hang up they
wait for the next voice conversation.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 230, 204), rgb(54, 33, 10)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));

g.text: After 60 s without a voice call (VOICE_GW_TELEGRAM_AFTER) the same
items also go to your Telegram chat, each once, interim updates not.
From Telegram it takes only /stop (kill switch), from your chat only.
On when .secrets/telegram_token and telegram_chat_id both exist.
Where workers run, and how changes reach GitHub

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 230, 204), rgb(54, 33, 10)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));
